maintenance.initial_phase: The initial isolated evaluation phase covers only the 14 frozen consumer cases through the real bounded index/read ports. Case IDs are budget identities, not host agent IDs; actual fresh consumer identities will be recorded separately.
controls: missing declared input and omitted dependency reject
recipe or authority/validity/gaps change propagates even equal prose
restore exact source and rebind, no stale fallback
required_before_maintenance: Freeze a distinct target plan before target production, including the concrete behavior edit, its expected observable consequences, producer recipe, identity and exact source/runtime pins.
Preserve the original obligation set and frozen S2-U1 graph; distinguish affected graph reachability from actual interpretation and recipe call counts.
Use the evaluation v2 rebuild path; legacy v1 maintenance cannot be used for v2 authority envelopes.
Obtain fresh result-specific semantic evidence for changed results and two new exact target admission decisions before any target admission.
Provide a separately reviewed evaluation-maintenance policy only after its prerequisites are satisfied; initial policy must not grant it.
Record invalidation, rebuild, current-reader refusal/restoration, reuse and recovery; do not relabel S2-U1 as executed, passed or not applicable before those observations.
maintenance.acceptance: No ADMIT criterion or final AC verdict is asserted by this plan. The adequacy of the initial-phase boundary and later target-plan sequence remains subject to the two independent admission reviewers.
